checkpoint: PR 1 of a maximum 2: complete Phoenix Islands area (8/8). The other 12 locations and four area scopes are pending PR 2.

area.name: Phoenix Islands
area.classification: justified physical named-archipelago grouping at broad island-group scale; exact land-source completeness unresolved
area.finding: The Kiribati-authored PIPA Management Plan identifies the Phoenix Islands as one of Kiribati’s three distinct island groups, west of the Line Islands and east of the Gilbert Islands. It names the same eight atoll/reef islands as this issue. This supports the physical grouping. The plan also documents two submerged reefs, seamounts, and a 408,250 km² surrounding marine protected property; these are not eight dry-land locations, and the PIPA marine boundary is not the WorldAtlas area footprint.
area.recommendation: Retain these eight named dry-land subjects in the Phoenix Islands area. Do not transfer the protected marine boundary into island footprints. Regional integration must review the coextensive Phoenix Islands province/area tiers consistently.

province.name: Phoenix Islands
province.classification: insufficient evidence for an independent administrative tier; its eight members are coextensive with the Phoenix Islands area
province.finding: The Kiribati PIPA plan describes an ecological management area, not a province-level civil government. Both the province and area currently contain exactly the same eight named locations. Kanton’s small caretaker population does not support a separate provincial tier.
province.recommendation: No hierarchy change in this packet. Regional integration should document a consistent geographic-tier exception or coordinate simplification across all eight members.

neighboring_consistency: The official PIPA plan places Phoenix between the Gilbert group to the west and Line Islands to the east. The eight assigned Phoenix OSM families are in separate source windows; retained comparison reports no current footprint intersections. A coordination lead from issue #611 (originating in #140) reports the retained Kiribati ADM1 ID gb:KIR:ADM1:97431129B36644055464690 is a two-component remainder of a 2017 source feature named Phoenix Islands near Banaba/Tarawa, currently under a Phoenix-named province within Gilbert area; sibling source ID is gb:KIR:ADM1:97431129B55805139245338. This cross-region source-identity/parent discrepancy is not independently reproduced in this packet and does not prove component-to-island lineage, a legal boundary, or ownership. Affected neighbors are this packet’s Phoenix province, area and eight location members, plus Gilbert/Line source IDs under #140/#139. Bounded crosswalk follow-up #611 coordinates with #526 and #404. Resolve identity and lineage there before any joint parent/boundary proposal; no shared boundary or parent is changed here. PIPA submerged reefs and seamounts are not converted into land subjects.
